question: The height of the net in volleyball for women must be ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2.24m**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The official net height for women's volleyball, as per FIVB (Fédération Internationale de Volleyball) regulations, is **2.24 meters**.
 
• In volleyball, the **official net height** varies based on gender, age, and the level of play.
 
• Volleyball is a **dynamic and exciting spor**t that has captured the attention of people all over the world.
 
• From its origins as a **fun game played on a beach to its current status as an Olympic sport, **Volleyball has well and truly come a long way.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **history of Volleyball** can be traced back to the late 19th century.
 
• The game was **first created by William G. Morgan,** a physical education instructor at the YMCA (Young Men's Christian Association) in Holyoke, Massachusetts, USA.
 
• In 1895,** Morgan was looking for a new game **that could be played indoors to provide an alternative to basketball, which had gained immense popularity during that time.
 
• Thus, **he developed Volleyball, originally known as "Mintonette."**
